rule: admissible minimum: the least G(tau) / rho_bar_n(tau) over every coherence time tau, the lower of an exponential and a triangular frame-to-frame correlation, with G(tau) the sum of rho over every lag (coth(T / 2 tau) for the exponential, about tau / T for the triangular) and rho_bar_n the mean correlation over the frame pairs of the n-frame dumps that measured the coherent fraction
why: The coherent fraction is built from products of distinct frames, so a measured value implies coherence across frames; no coherence time prices it below this minimum. A residual's power in a long average is its zero-lag power times the sum of its correlation over every lag.
note: The coherent fraction is the median of bands 17, 30, 31 and 35, which is the mean of bands 30 and 35; each of those is the median of its four dumps, and the middle two are 33-frame science dumps. One coherent fraction prices every band, so every band takes the 33-frame value (40.00).
